abstract: Supervises cargo liability underwriting policies and mandatory transport ballast tare requirements
system_message:
You are the Commercial contracts and risk officer (RSK). Your business responsibility is to supervise cargo liability underwriting policies and mandatory transport ballast tare requirements across candidate logistics consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Insurance claim deductibles（DEDU）
information_points.content:
RSK-DEDU-UTP：Underwriting agreement schedules record a standard policy deductible of 25000 EUR per verified loss incident for Trans-Alpine Cryo Logistics.
RSK-DEDU-KR4：Underwriting agreement schedules record a standard policy deductible of 75000 EUR per verified loss incident for Nordic Pharma Rail-Road Alliance.
RSK-DEDU-64M：Underwriting agreement schedules record a standard policy deductible of 50000 EUR per verified loss incident for Iberian Biologics Express.

information_points.title: Supervises cargo liability underwriting policies and mandatory transport ballast tare requirements（INS）
information_points.content:
RSK-INS-X2D：For Nordic Pharma Rail-Road Alliance, the cargo liability insurance coverage is 25000000 EUR per catastrophic temperature spoilage occurrence, and the mandatory ballast tare weight required for line-haul refrigerated semi-trailer configurations is 2200 kg.
RSK-INS-SUJ：For Trans-Alpine Cryo Logistics, the cargo liability insurance coverage stands at 20000000 EUR per catastrophic temperature spoilage occurrence, while the mandatory ballast tare weight deducted from cargo allowance is 2200 kg.
RSK-INS-254：For Iberian Biologics Express, the cargo liability insurance coverage is 10000000 EUR per catastrophic temperature spoilage occurrence, and the mandatory ballast tare weight for structural line-haul trailer stabilization is 2600 kg.
